text: Muang Thai Life Assurance Public Company Limited is held by Muang Thai Group Holding Co., Ltd. (75.00003%) and Ageas Insurance International N.V. (24.99990%), with others holding 0.00007% (MTL IR Fact Sheet, board data as of 31 March 2025).
short: MTL is 75.0% held by Muang Thai Group Holding and 25.0% by Ageas Insurance International.

source.name: Muang Thai Life Assurance PCL: IR Fact Sheet Vol.96 (Q1/2025), shareholding section
source.quote: MTL SHAREHOLDING PROPORTION OVERSEAS INVESTMENT Muang Thai Group  Holding Co., Ltd. 75.00003% Ageas Insurance  International NV 24.99990%
source.note: Company-stated shareholder split; double spaces reproduce the PDF text extraction. MTL converted to a public limited company on 1 Oct 2012 but this float of 0.00007% shows it is effectively unlisted.
